proves.claim: With laneMode off, a commit touching only the claimed item's cells passes pre-commit and submit.

cli.journeys-join-lanes-off-cells.own-ce.why: Without it, the three cell slices could each pass alone while a real seat still met the lane folders at commit or submit.

proves.claim: With laneMode off, a commit touching a path outside the claimed item's cells is refused naming the path.

cli.journeys-join-lanes-off-cells.foreig.why: Without it, dropping the lane folders could leave a seat free to edit any cell.

proves.claim: With laneMode off, next never hands a second seat an item in a cell the first seat's claim holds.

cli.journeys-join-lanes-off-cells.held-c.why: Without it, two seats could build in one cell once the lane folders stop separating them.
